explanation: This unit tracks the agent current preference: it is high while the agent keeps choosing a1 (GO about 8-9; D2 about 9-10 on reaching S1, about 7 on reaching S2) and low while it keeps choosing a2 (GO about 3-4; D2 about 1-2 on reaching S2, about 4 on reaching S1). At D1 it is 9-10 after an unrewarded trial and about 5 after a rewarded one during a1 runs, and about 3 after an unrewarded trial and 0-1 after a rewarded one during a2 runs, with values in between (5-7) for the first trials after a switch.
